## Installing jamovi

PGM is an add-on module for jamovi. Before installing the module, download and install the current version of jamovi from its [official website](https://www.jamovi.org/download.html).

After installation, open jamovi and verify that the main analysis interface is working correctly.

## Installing PGM from the jamovi library

PGM is available in the official jamovi library:

1.  Open jamovi.

2.  Select the Modules icon, in the upper-right of Analysis menu.

3.  Open the jamovi module library.

4.  Search for PGM.

5.  Select Install.

After installation, PGM will appear in the main analysis ribbon.

## Installing a development version

Development versions may be distributed as .jmo files on [PGM GitHub repository](https://github.com/apessina/jamovi-PGM).

1.  To install a local module:

2.  Open jamovi.

3.  Select the Modules icon.

4.  Select Sideload.

5.  Locate the .jmo file.

6.  Confirm the installation.

Development versions may contain recently added features that have not yet been included in a stable release.

## Updating PGM

When PGM is installed through the jamovi library, available updates can be installed through the module manager.

For reproducible academic work, record the PGM and jamovi versions.

## Verifying the installation

After installation, open a dataset containing numeric time and response variables. The module includes example datasets for testing and learning purposes. They are available from the jamovi menu in the upper-left corner: **Open → Data Library → PGM**.

Next, select **Growth** from the analysis ribbon and open **Curve Modeling**. Assign at least one response variable and one time variable.

If the analysis interface opens and produces an initial result, the module has been installed successfully.

## Reporting problems

When reporting an error, include:

- the PGM version;

- the jamovi version;

- the operating system;

- the selected model and options;

- the complete error message;

- a reproducible or anonymized dataset, when possible.
